params.sqlrunner: Custom SQLRunner; when empty, an ODPSRunner is created by default
params.env_path: Optional .env path; environment variables are loaded when provided
params.n_process: SQL/check concurrency; auto/null means the CPU core count minus one

level2.name: DataFrame Mode

params.offline_data: Offline DataFrame, which can be passed through config or run()
params.online_data: Online DataFrame, which can be passed through config or run()

rules: DataFrame mode is entered as soon as either offline_data or online_data exists
DataFrame mode must provide both offline_data and online_data

params.random_state: Random seed, currently kept mainly for configuration consistency
params.write_excel: Whether to call checker.export_excel to output Excel

params.comparison_block_size: Feature-column block size for the wide-table per-flow consistency comparison, default 128

params.excel_output_path: Excel output path; when empty, output_dir/report/Score_Consistency_UAT_Report.xlsx is used
params.info_list: Extra information columns shown in the per-flow report

level2.name: numeric coercion

params.numeric_coercion_min_ratio: Minimum parsable share for converting an object column to numeric in safe mode

rules: In safe mode, conversion happens only when the parsable share reaches numeric_coercion_min_ratio
aggressive mode forces conversion, values that cannot be parsed become NaN, and a warning is logged
off mode does no numeric conversion of object columns

requirement_note: The required category contains the data source that UAT must choose; pick one of SQL mode and DataFrame mode.

excel_output_path.config_key: excel_output_path resolved under output_dir/report if empty

comparison_block_size.meaning: Number of fields in each column block of the vectorized comparison

numeric_coercion_min_ratio.meaning: Minimum parsable share for converting an object column to numeric in safe mode
